fact__v5.instructions: What new FACT about the watched fighter does the article carry, if any? A fact is something that happened or is set to happen, not an opinion about him. Choose by the article's main news. An interview, a press conference or a media day is a place where things are said, not a fact: if something said there is the news, choose that fact, or none if it is only talk.

next_fight.what: News of his next fight: an opponent, a date, an offer, talks, a cancellation, or when he will be ready to fight again.
next_fight.not_for: His injury or recovery itself, with no word on when he can fight (that is health); a wish or an opinion about who he should fight, such as a callout or a pundit's pick (that is no fact).
examples: The promotion announces his bout for March.
His coach says he will be ready to fight by December.

result.what: The outcome of a fight of his.

fight_week_event.what: The routine of a fight of his, and nothing more: a weigh-in, a face-off, an open workout, the card order, start times, how to watch.

health.what: An injury, a medical issue, surgery or recovery.
health.not_for: Only when he will be ready to fight again, with no injury or recovery described (that is his next fight).
examples: He had knee surgery and is in rehab.
He pulled out with a broken hand.

career_move.what: Retirement, a contract, a move of weight class or team, a title vacated, stripped or awarded.

personal_life.what: His life outside the cage: family, childhood, home, hobbies, money, a life lesson.

no_fact.what: Only opinion or talk: no new fact about him.

none_of_these.what: None of the options above describes this article; a different answer is needed.

act__v5.instructions: What does the source do regarding the watched fighter? Pick the one the article's main news is built on.

reports_an_event.what: Nobody's words are the news: something happened - he fought, weighed in, faced off, was booked, a fight of his was announced or cancelled.

speaks_of_himself.what: He himself talks about his own situation, plans, past, condition, fight or life.
speaks_of_himself.not_for: a reply by him to an attack aimed at him (that is answers_for_him)
examples: how he rates himself
his own forecast for his fight
what he wants next

assesses_him.what: Someone other than him judges him: his level, chances, performance, condition, style, place in the division.

predicts_his_fight.what: Someone other than him gives a pick or forecast for a specific fight of his: who wins, how, in which round.

calls_him_out.what: Someone other than him asks to fight him, challenges him, or trash-talks him.

answers_for_him.what: A reply to an attack, a callout or a claim aimed at him - made on his behalf by someone else, or by him.

steers_him.what: Someone other than him says what he should do next: whom he should fight, whether a rematch should happen, when to return, which weight class - including demands made on his behalf.
steers_him.not_for: what he himself says he wants next

gives_news_of_him.what: Someone other than him gives a factual update about him: his condition, recovery, training, whereabouts, mood or plans.
gives_news_of_him.not_for: a judgement of how good he is (that is assesses_him)

none_of_these.what: None of the options above describes this article; a different answer is needed.
